body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: fb957ec717ac20320c8bb3157291073e78cce924 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

What looks good
- The browser Setups row now stands whenever Setup is open, and the ribbon has a Setups cell targeting UiTarget::Setups (panes.rs). Both draw Icon::Fixture, which is already wired in icons.rs (existing fixture.png), so no new asset or LICENSES.md change.
- Create first setup still goes through the queued CreateSetup command. The new kittest checks the ribbon click, the creation, undo, and the return to the no-setup page.
- No unwrap/expect/panic added in non-test code. Layering is intact (ui calls actions::target). The new test file has a provenance line. The body has a Changelog: line and ends Fixes #322. The decision file is under docs/decisions.
- Snapshots (egui_app.png, compared against main's golden): only the Setups ribbon cell appears, with the other cells re-spaced, and one Setups browser row, with the rows below moved down one. No other change.

Local results (trial merge with origin/main: up to date, no conflicts)
- camcraft-ui --lib (from crates/ui): 283 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored
- --test egui_app (from crates/ui): 3 passed
- clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -D warnings: clean

Requested before merge: none.

Notes (not blocking)
- panes.rs and tests.rs were already over 400 lines. This PR adds about 10 lines to panes.rs.
- The MCP server has no setup tool. That is out of scope here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
